description:
We are all one throughout the universe.

A few days before the competition, I had a dream that guided me toward this challenge, even though I had no prior awareness of it. I don't know why Iran was not included among the country options. I don't know the reason behind it, but I have a strong feeling that Planet Earth is moving toward a future without borders.

I believe NASA is an organization whose mission is to care for and protect our planet.
